program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const isAtTop = t >= apexTime; const dropTime = isAtTop ? t - apexTime : 0; const dropVelocity = isAtTop ? -gravity * dropTime : 0; const dropAcceleration = isAtTop ? -gravity : 0; const dropHeight = isAtTop ? apexHeight - (gravity * dropTime * dropTime) / 2 : apexHeight; const panelY = 50; const panelH = 340; const scaleY = 110; const baseY = panelY + panelH - 30; const tossX = 180; const dropX = 460; const laneW = 240; let tossState = "Rising"; if (t < 0.05) tossState = "At launch"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime) tossState = "Falling"; if (t > 2 * apexTime - 0.05) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (t > apexTime) dropState = "Falling together"; if (t > 2 * apexTime - 0.05) dropState = "At launch height"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: panelY, w: laneW, h: panelH, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: panelY, w: laneW, h: panelH, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); const tossBallY = baseY - tossedHeight * scaleY; const dropBallY = baseY - dropHeight * scaleY; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, tossBallY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, dropBallY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 25, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 20, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 25, y: tossBallY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 25, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 20, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 25, y: dropBallY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, label: "a" })); const gateY = baseY - apexHeight * scaleY; objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, gateY, { open: isAtTop, label: "Apex gate" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, tossBallY - 20, [`v: ${tossedVelocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${tossedAcceleration.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, dropBallY - 20, [`v: ${dropVelocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${dropAcceleration.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. The gate releases a second ball at that moment. Both then fall together from rest.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball on the left and a dropped ball on the right. Velocity and acceleration vectors accompany each ball along with live numerical readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
